title: Sports E-commerce Redesign
subtitle: A full redesign of a sports retailer's mobile and desktop web — new brand, new design system, and a coupon system rebuilt from the ground up.
description: Sports E-commerce Redesign Case Study (incl. Coupon Deep-Dive)

intro.paragraph: A full redesign of a sports retailer's mobile and desktop web, featuring a new brand identity, a new design system, and a coupon system rebuilt from the ground up. The coupon system is presented as a Deep-Dive inside the larger redesign — the flagship example of standardisation paying off.

challenge: Stagnating growth with retention flat, usability issues hurting UX and SEO, feature friction making new features hard to implement, and a new rebrand needed across the entire e-commerce experience.

goals.goal: Standardise the experience so new features ship faster
